name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Chef's Scratch Chicken Noodle Soup & Sourdough Roll
whyItWorks: Golden chicken bone broth simmered with tender shredded chicken, soft egg noodles, and cooked carrots. Hydrating, electrolyte-rich, and therapeutic for inflamed intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle a bowl of chicken noodle soup at the hot soup bar; pair with a soft sourdough dinner roll.
